title: Protecting Our Kids from Harmful Research Act
latestAction: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
summary:
Protecting Our Kids from Harmful Research Act

This bill prohibits the use of federal funds for research or publications concerning gender transition in individuals under the age of 18.
